def avg_rate(series):
    """Return the overall average rate of change per unit time."""
    if len(series) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least two measurements are required.")

    time_change = series[-1][0] - series[0][0]
    if time_change == 0:
        raise ValueError("The total time change must be nonzero.")

    value_change = series[-1][1] - series[0][1]
    return f"{value_change / time_change:.2f}"
